notes: the two helpers the body calls (create_public_links and remove_public_links, local.rb:21-42) touch the file system, so their own bytes are NOT executed here; the capture records which of the two the body asked for

scenarios.name: a local attachment whose content is blank: the body returns before it touches the links
a local attachment anyone may read: the body asks to create the public links
a local attachment nobody but the owner may read: the body asks to remove the public links
